Name: Friendly Hutch Slimes
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=4][quote]You raised these slimes from eggs, and [i]this [/i]is how they repay you???[/quote][/size]
[b][color=#93c47d]Slimes [/color][/b]in your Hutch (and [b]ONLY [/b]inside the hutch) are now friendly, or at least non-aggressive. 
- Disables their player aggro (so they don't run at you)
- Sets their damage to 0
- Nudges the [color=#93c47d][b]Slimes [/b][/color]away if they're within 2 tiles (so you don't get crowded)
- The Magic Quiver Trinket wont attack your Hutch Slimes

If you stand on top of a Slime, they might occasionally lunge in your direction, but it wont hurt you and they'll go back to minding their own business after.

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+  
• SMAPI
